summary: Sprint-3 Explainability Closure tests completed successfully. All backend APIs (17/17 tests passed) and frontend UI flows verified. Decision Cards display LONG/SHORT/BLOCKED/NO_TRADE labels, scores, families, risk badges, learning badges, and Explainability buttons. Explainability Drawer shows final decision, family gate statuses, source strategy contributions, blocked reason timeline, and explanation templates. Admin Strategy Family Gates panel shows all 4 families (trend/breakout/pullback/reversal) with editable gate parameters.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sprint-3 explainability flow is complete. UserScannerPage displays decision cards with 10s auto-refresh polling. ExplainabilityDrawer opens on button click and shows full decision trace. Admin Strategy Family Gates panel allows editing all 4 family gate configurations. All data-testid attributes are in place.

decision_cards.dominant_family: Shows dominant family or '-' if none

explainability_drawer.title: Shows symbol name and description
explainability_drawer.family_gates: Shows gate status per family (REJECTED, ACCEPTED, etc.) with reason
explainability_drawer.source_strategies: Lists strategies with family, raw signal, contribution, status (rejected/gated/accepted)
explainability_drawer.blocked_timeline: Shows time-ordered events with layer, reason, state transitions

admin_family_gates.panel_location: Bottom of Canonical Strategy Registry page

api_tests_summary.GET /api/user/decision-cards: 200 - returns envelope with schema_version, engine_version, generated_at, items
api_tests_summary.GET /api/user/explainability/{symbol}: 200/404 - returns full explainability with family_scores, source_strategies, blocked_reason_timeline, explanation_templates
